title: At 26, the Finish Line Looked Close
tldr: A friend I have had since I was twelve told me he is seriously ill. He is 26. In the same week I met a newborn at his start line, MDFLD posted for the first time in three months, and I renewed my outlook on time.

title: The Search That Should Have Been the Start
tldr: One evening I hunted a single pair of boots across eBay, Instagram, Depop, Facebook Marketplace and half a dozen boutique stores, knocking on every door but the right one. The anger that followed built the thing MDFLD should have started with almost two years ago, and it now indexes about thirty one thousand listings from our little server.

title: Large Visual Models Don't Exist Yet. I Want to Build Them.
tldr: What you could not do six months ago, you can do now. The world is using AI as a search box while it quietly became a build tool, and the thing I intend to build with it is the LLM equivalent for the visual world.
